caption: The drawing is a monochromatic pencil illustration on a cream-colored background, depicting a detailed ornate pitcher with decorative elements. The central object is a pitcher with a wide spout, flared lip, and curving handle, which is embellished with scrollwork and leaf motifs. The body of the pitcher features symmetrical floral designs in relief, including large central flowers and leafy patterns extending vertically. Above and to the left of the pitcher, there is a close-up elevation view of the handle, showing its elaborate ornamentation and attachment to the pitcher. To the upper right, a similarly detailed view displays one of the decorative motifs from the body of the pitcher, framed with curvilinear lines. In the lower left corner, a small rectangular inset contains a simplified profile outline of the pitcher with dimension annotations: 5¼ inches tall, 2¾ inches wide, and 1¾ inches deep. The drawing is executed in fine black pencil or ink lines, with shading to render the three-dimensional forms and textures of the metalwork. The artist’s signature, "S. Weidn," is present in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Creamer
